channel.title: The Argo: the house of dith.eth
channel.description: What happened to the Argonauts and Leaves of one house.

item.title: Antimnikos #111 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scatt
item.description: Antimnikos #111 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (plague). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.
